title: Headless runner once guard fix2 review
scope: Offline review of fix2 for pre-existing evidence protection and state-output ownership. No emulator/core was started.

verification.temporary_probe: reserve_outputs accepts state_out equal to the new run directory; verified in a temporary directory.

confirmed_fixes: The output run directory must not exist; mkdir is the atomic, permanent reservation, including after child failure.
Any pre-existing run directory is rejected, covering stale logs, DSVs, inputs, and empty directories without output-name allowlists.
A state-out path must be absent and resolve beneath the newly reserved run directory, preventing shared external state paths.
The pinned runner SHA-256 is checked before reservation or launch.

finding.summary: A state-out path equal to the run directory itself is accepted, although it is not a file path strictly below that directory.
evidence: state_out.resolve().relative_to(run_dir) succeeds when both resolved paths are equal, returning an empty relative path.
A temporary-directory probe confirmed reserve_outputs returns successfully and creates the run directory for this input.
The pinned runner later calls write_bytes on state_out after processing frames; if state_out is the run directory, that write fails as a directory.
finding.impact: An invalid invocation can run the emulator before failing during state serialization, leaving a reserved partial run. This does not re-open the prior-output overwrite issue.
finding.recommendation: Require the resolved state-out path to be a strict descendant of run_dir, rejecting equality before child launch.

limits: The original pre-existing-evidence overwrite finding is closed by requiring a new run directory; this review does not cover general process concurrency or filesystem policy.
